name: repeft_dora_alpha_failure_r64
description: DoRA α-driven failure replication on REPEFT cluster (independent verification of MultiAgent finding). BERT-base / MNLI 50K, r=64, vary α ∈ {32, 48, 56, 64, 72} (α/r ∈ {0.5, 0.75, 0.875, 1.0, 1.125}), 5 seeds each = 25 jobs.
base_command: python3 real_lora_classify.py --model bert-base-uncased --dataset nyu-mll/glue --dataset-config mnli --train-split train --eval-split validation_matched --text-field-a premise --text-field-b hypothesis --label-field label --metric accuracy --output-dir . --peft-method dora --lr 1e-4 --lora-r 64 --lora-alpha {alpha} --lora-dropout 0.05 --num-epochs 3 --batch-size 16 --seq-length 256 --max-samples 50000 --max-eval-samples 1000 --seed {seed}
